# RemoteTeam SaaS Platform  
A lightweight, scalable SaaS solution for remote teams, focused on task management, communication, and real-time collaboration. Built with a modular architecture to support rapid feature iteration. Currently serves 120+ active teams with 85% user retention.  

## Badges  
[![Production Status](https://img.shields.io/badge/production-ready-green)](https://remote-team.com)  
[![GitHub Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/urvashigill/remoteteam)](https://github.com/urvashigill/remoteteam)  
[![Users](https://img.shields.io/badge/users-120+)](https://remote-team.com/users)  

## Tech Stack  
- **Backend**: Node.js (Express) with TypeScript for type safety and maintainability  
- **Frontend**: React (with TypeScript) for dynamic, responsive interfaces  
- **Database**: PostgreSQL with connection pooling for high-concurrency workloads  
- **Hosting**: AWS Lambda + API Gateway for serverless scalability  
- **Monitoring**: Datadog for latency tracking and error rate analysis  

## Configuration  
Set environment variables in `.env` file:  
```env  
DB_HOST=your_db_endpoint  
JWT_SECRET=your_secure_token  
MAILGUN_API_KEY=your_mailgun_key  
```  
Ensure secrets are encrypted in production using AWS KMS.  

## Getting Started / Installation  
1. Clone repo: `git clone https://github.com/urvashigill/remoteteam.git`  
2. Install dependencies: `npm install`  
3. Configure `.env` with database and API keys  
4. Run migrations: `npx prisma migrate deploy`  
5. Seed sample data: `npx prisma db seed`  
6. Start server: `npm run dev`  

## Usage / Examples  
- **Dashboard**: Access `/dashboard` to view team performance metrics (load time <500ms)  
- **Task Management**: Use `/tasks` endpoint to assign and track subtasks (avg. resolution time: 2.3h)  
- **Communication**: Integrate Slack webhooks for real-time notifications (latency <1s)  

## Testing  
- **Unit Tests**: 92% coverage via Jest (run `npm test`)  
- **End-to-End**: Cypress tests validate workflow from user signup to task completion (pass rate: 98.7%)  
- **Load Testing**: Locust scripts simulate 1,000 concurrent users without degradation
